recent_alerts.text:
🔄 Start Peyton Watson over Ty Jerome in Util

Watson is now healthy and has 1 game left (Sun 10:00 KST). Ty Jerome has 0 games left this week, so his Util spot is wasted.

Move: Bench Jerome, start Watson in Util. No add used (6 left).

Deadline: before Watson's tip-off, Sun 10:00 KST.

🔀 Start Jalen Johnson, bench Ty Jerome

ESPN now lists Johnson as healthy. He's on your bench with a game Sun 09:30 KST.
Swap him into Util for Ty Jerome, who has 0 games left this week, so you lose nothing.
Make the change before Johnson's tip-off at 09:30 KST. No add needed; 6 adds remain.

🚨 Paul George is out, so move him to IL and start a bench player

- George (illness) is ruled out for tonight's game vs Toronto, which tips Thu 09:00 KST. He's still in your active SF slot, so that spot scores nothing.
- Move him to the one open IL spot and start Payton Pritchard (BOS, plays Thu 09:00) or another bench player who fits SF/Util. Check eligibility in the app.
- Karl-Anthony Towns (calf, day-to-day) is questionable for Thu 09:00 KST. Decide before tip-off whether to keep him in F or swap in Peyton Watson or Matas Buzelis.
- Ajay M

🚨 Move Ajay Mitchell off IL to an active spot

He's now Day-To-Day (left ankle sprain), not Out. He's already ruled out for Wed (Pacific), but he can't stay in an IL slot. Yahoo may flag that, and it could block adds.
Move him to BN or Util before his next game, Sat 12:30 KST.
Don't drop anyone. One IL slot is empty either way.
Adds: 4 left this week, pending Yahoo confirmation.

🚨 Move Grayson Allen into your SG slot before 13:00 KST

Ty Jerome (SG) is out tonight with a hip injury, so he won't score for you Wednesday. Allen (CHA) is on your bench and plays today at 13:00 KST, so he can fill that spot.

Set Allen as SG and move Jerome to the bench before 13:00 KST, the tip-off that locks him.

Jerome's next game is Thu 09:00 KST, so he can return to the lineup

🚨 Activate Paul George from IL to an active slot

ESPN now lists him healthy, and his next game is Wed 10:00 KST (BOS). Move him off IL before then so he can play.

Once he's activated, bench or swap one of your active players to make room, since he's currently on IL. Check that Mitchell and Suggs are still listed as injured. Those IL spots are the ones that need to stay valid.

Deadline: before Wed 10:00 KST.

🏀 Giannis is trending healthy, so check his lineup before Thu tip-off

Giannis (MIA, BN) is Day-To-Day with a groin issue, but he participated in most of Tuesday's practice. He has 3 games left this week, and his next game is Thu 07:00 KST.

If he's cleared closer to tip-off, move him from BN into an active slot and bench your weakest active player. I can't rank your active players without stats, so use your own read.

Deadline: lineup locks at his tip-off, Thu 07:00 KST. Check his status around 06:00 KST.

🔁 Move Jaylen Brown to IL, activate Giannis

Brown is out for Friday's game, so he's dead weight in your SF slot. Giannis is probable for Friday's game vs the Knicks and has 2 games left.
Yahoo's IL rules should allow Brown (Out) on IL, which frees the SF spot for Giannis.
Your Nov 26 notes say this swap is planned but not confirmed done. Please check your lineup in the Yahoo app.
Deadline: before Giannis tips off, Sat 09:00 KST. If he's ruled out before then, leave Brown where he is and start your best healthy bench player in SF.
No adds are needed for this. You still have 6 adds left.

🚨 Towns is questionable. Set your C slot before 09:00 KST

KAT (NYK, C) is questionable for Friday vs Miami with an abdominal bruise. His game is Sat 09:00 KST, so his slot locks at that tip.

If he's active, leave him in C. If he's ruled out, start Ivica Zubac (IND, BN, plays Sat 09:30 KST, 2 games left) at C. Paul Reed (DET, BN, Sat 09:30 KST) is the alternate.

Check the official injury report around 08:00 KST. Decide before 09:00 KST.

🚨 Move Jaylen Brown to IL, activate Giannis

Brown (hamstring) is Out and will miss his next two games, including Sun 10:30 KST, so his SF slot is dead for the week. The planned swap wasn't confirmed, so check the app first: if Brown is still in SF, move him to IL and bring Giannis (1 game left, Mon 05:30 KST) out of IL, if he's healthy.

Fill SF with a bench player who plays this week, such as Trae Young (Sun 07:00 KST) or Jalen Johnson (Mon 08:00 KST).

Deadline: before Sun 10:30 KST.
